newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece's Metka plans 3-for-10 scrip issue.
newsitem.headline: Greece's Metka plans 3-for-10 scrip issue.

text.p: Greece's metal construction firm Metka got shareholder approval for a three-for-10 scrip issue at the annual shareholders meeting held on Thursday.

Metka will capitalise asset revaluation and share premium reserves totalling 1.499 billion drachmas. It will issue a total of 1,498,575 bonus shares and raise share par value from 350 drachmas to 500.
Metka will distribute a dividend per share of 100 drachmas, up from 80 a year earlier. It will trade ex-dividend June 6.
The uncompleted portion of its order book stood at 25 billion drachmas on June 1, following the addition of projects valued at 5 billion drachmas in the first five months of 1997, it said.
Metka's pretax earnings rose 36 percent to 1.82 billion drachmas in fiscal 1996 on turnover growth of 25 percent to 15.7 billion.
Its shares lost 40 drachmas to close at 3,940 on Thursday on volume of 39,280 shares.
